title: Skin
description: A pixel-crisp early-2000s media player in three windows: a scrolling title marquee, a live spectrum analyser and oscilloscope drawn from herb's beat, a ten-band equaliser that really filters it, and a Beatles playlist. Drag the windows by their frames and they snap and dock together, and moving the main window carries the docked ones with it.
intent: One period object finished to the edge: every pixel of the skin is drawn on tiny canvases scaled by whole device pixels, and every readout is real, from the FFT behind the bars to the biquad filters behind the EQ sliders.
sources: herb reference board: Y2K found-footage montage (fa23bcd4), CRT green terminal text and early-2000s media objects
